title: Sales By Representative Expanded CSV and PDF look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Today has one invoiced split work order (Labor {Sales-rep-A}, Parts {Sales-rep-B}).
  • The design canvas is open in another tab at page 4, boards 4.11 and 4.12.
    For example: the canvas is https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open for today in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Export the Expanded CSV and compare it with board 4.11.
  2. Export the Expanded PDF and compare it with board 4.12.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Sales Type column after Status; the cells of the side a row is not credited with are blank.
  • Step 2: the Sales Type column after Status; those cells show a dash; layout as in the picture.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S5-R23, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, page 4, boards 4.11 and 4.12, used for the picture to compare against. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

The design's export pictures show 0.00 / $0.00 under Shop Supplies on the Parts row; the PRD says blank in the CSV and a dash in the PDF. This case follows the PRD; the difference is on the product owner's question list.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R23: “The Expanded CSV and the Expanded PDF always carry the Sales Type column, after Status, whatever the screen shows. In them, the cells of the side a row is not credited with are blank in the CSV and show a dash in the PDF.”
